speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact location of your chest pain and what you were doing when it started. Are you currently short of breath or sweating?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a heavy weight squeezing it. It started suddenly an hour ago while I was just working at my desk, and yes, I am definitely short of breath and have started sweating. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; please clarify if the "stroke team" refers to a cardiologist evaluating a heart attack, as your symptoms of central crushing pain, shortness of breath, and sweating are classic for acute coronary syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Troponin level.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Troponin I Levels: Elevated at 0.4 ng/mL (normal <0.01 ng/mL)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (likely Acute Myocardial Infarction).
